subject: Aligning on on-prem pilot calendar & ops preflight
messages:
From: Marta Romero <marta.romero@averyhealth.com>
To: sales@redwood.ai, sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
Cc: 
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Request: on-prem demo for regulated POC

Hi Redwood sales team,

We self-registered for a trial earlier today and our security/compliance team needs an on-prem (air-gapped) demo focused on: tenant isolation, audit logs, and KMS integrations. This is for a HIPAA-regulated pilot; the decision committee includes IT ops and security -- I work on the product team.

Preferred window: week of May 3, mornings PST.

Could someone from your team run a 45–60 minute technical walkthrough and confirm what pre-demo evidence you can provide (SOC2 scope, sample audit logs, and a network diagram)? Also please include any deployment constraints for air-gapped environments.

Thanks,
Marta Romero
Product Manager, Avery Health

Avery Health | marta.romero@averyhealth.com

Hi Marta — thanks for signing up and for the clear ask. I can run the technical walkthrough; I want to loop in Vivek (SDR/ops handoff) to line up scheduling and Mina (security lead) for evidence.

Proposed slots (45 minutes):
- Tue May 4, 09:00–09:45 PT
- Wed May 5, 09:30–10:15 PT
- Thu May 6, 08:30–09:15 PT

If those don't work, tell me the best morning window your IT ops folks have and we will adjust. Quick notes: we support private deployments (VPC/on‑prem). For air-gapped installs we typically provide a preflight checklist and a network topology template in advance. Mina will follow up with the evidence index.

Also: who from IT ops should be on the call (name + email) so we can include any infrastructure folks in the calendar invite?

Cheers,

From: Marta Romero <marta.romero@averyhealth.com>

Cc: IT Ops <itops@averyhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: on-prem demo for regulated POC

Thanks Sean — Wed May 5 morning looks best for us. Please book May 5 at 09:30 PT and include IT Ops (itops@averyhealth.com).

Two quick constraints from security:
1) We are in a strict PST operational window; please avoid scheduling outside 08:00–12:00 PT.
2) Before the call, we need a brief list of the exact artifacts you'll share (SOC2 type II scope, sample audit-log export format, and confirmation of KMS/HSM options). Also confirm whether your preflight requires outbound connectivity to a Redwood-controlled endpoint (if so, we need IP ranges).

I'll be on the call along with our lead systems engineer (cc'd). If you can get the checklist and a short network diagram ahead of the meeting that would speed approvals.

Best,
Marta
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Romero <marta.romero@averyhealth.com>, itops@averyhealth.com
Cc: sean_gallagher@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 1 May 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: on-prem demo for regulated POC — pre-demo artifacts and calendar invite

Hi Marta and Avery IT team — Mina from Redwood security/solutions here. Thanks for confirming May 5 at 09:30 PT; Sean/Vivek will send the invite. Attaching our preflight checklist and a short evidence index to this thread. Quick answers inline: 

- SOC2: we will provide a SOC2 Type II report excerpt that covers our control environment for inference and the audit scope. (Attachment: security-evidence-index.csv)
- Audit logs: we can provide sample exports (JSON/CSV) and a description of retention controls.
- KMS/HSM: we support customer-managed keys (KMS) integrations and can discuss HSM options in the call.
- Network: our preflight requires the on‑prem runner to be able to pull a signed image from a customer-approved artifact repository. For air‑gapped installs we support an offline bundle; if you choose online bootstrap, we will share minimal IP ranges.

Attachments included:
- redwood-preflight-checklist.pdf (step-by-step items we run pre-install)
- security-evidence-index.csv (which evidence we can provide and delivery ETA)
- network-topology-diagram.png (example topology for private deployment)

Related links: drive doc with the detailed checklist: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3c-preflight-doc

I will join May 5 and be prepared to walk through the checklist for the security reviewers. If you need the attachments in a sealed transfer (SFTP/secure link) instead of email, let me know and we will arrange it.

Thanks — Mina Haddad
Security Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai
